## Summary

Built Federal Marketplace Assessor prototype (assess.py). A runnable Python prototype providing one-command PSC code market assessments for small software teams. Uses cached E206 experiment data for instant results. Validated: 7030 PROCEED (best for direct sales, 3,916 recipients, 32.1% ≤0k), DA10 PROCEED (best for GSA Schedule/GWAC, 28% small vendor GSA MAS share). Prototype addresses concrete problem: small teams have no easy way to assess federal marketplace opportunities. Key artifact: assess.py (new file). Next: either generate complete cached experiment data by running E206 CLI with all modules, or design and recruit for E208 field test with 3-5 small software companies.

## Next
